items.reason: Gap 0 describes simultaneous duplicate deliveries both passing the pre-handler check before the post-handler insert and being processed twice.
Gap 1 states that deduplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body id and explains spoofing it.
Gap 3 identifies charge.refunded as the provider event and refund.created as the handler name, causing real refunds to reach no handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
